rules.why: Browser and computer use have no other OS path, so the default install carries them.
Desktop payloads work offline, so they carry every optional tool and extra.
faster-whisper has no Windows ARM64 wheel; whisper.cpp is local STT there.

Containers often cannot reach PyPI for lazy installs, so the image bakes the adapters and provider SDKs users enable most. matrix's python-olm needs the image's native build toolchain, which is why it is not in [all].
